ModMetaData.name: Era Appropriate Threats
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Keeps the threats your colony faces in step with its technology. A spiritual successor to Ignorance Is Bliss, written from scratch.
Your colony's tech level follows your research. Raids, mech clusters, infestations and hostile quest sites only come from factions within the range you choose. A raid that would have come from outside the range is given to a faction inside it. If none can come, the closest faction comes instead, or you can choose to skip the raid.
Every faction can be set to come by tech level, always or never, including factions added by other mods. Insects always come by default.
Not compatible with Ignorance Is Bliss. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
